metadata.title: Middle School A+++ Advanced Studio Art — 13-Week Course
frameworks: National Core Arts Standards — Visual Arts: Creating, Presenting, Responding, Connecting
National Core Arts Standards — High School Advanced
AP Art and Design portfolio framework: Sustained Investigation and Selected Works
College-level studio habits: inquiry, experimentation, revision, documentation, critique

course_goals: Build strong foundations in drawing, color, composition, design, sculpture, printmaking, mixed media, and digital art.
Move students from following examples toward making intentional artistic choices.
Develop critique, revision, reflection, and portfolio habits.
Connect technique with meaning, identity, culture, audience, and context.
Prepare students for advanced high-school studio work.

weeks.weekly_goal: Develop mastery of foundations of advanced visual thinking through creating, presenting, responding, and connecting.

lessons.title: Seeing Like an Artist
objectives: Develop advanced middle school skills in seeing like an artist.
Apply artistic processes intentionally rather than by imitation.
Document choices, experimentation, feedback, revision, and reflection.
activities: Study exemplars and identify artistic decisions.
Teacher demonstration and technique analysis.
Focused studio practice with experimentation.
Peer critique using criteria and evidence.
Revise, document, and reflect on artistic decisions.
lessons.assessment: Process evidence, studio artifact, critique contribution, and reflection.
lessons.extension: Independent variation, additional medium, or self-directed refinement.
